candidate_breakdown.q1_text: Hello my name is Aliya and I apply to inVision U because I really want grow not only like student but like person who can do useful things with other people. I am not very strong in presenting myself maybe, but I know for me only university classes is not enough. I need place where people do real work, real projects, and learn by action not only by theory.
candidate_breakdown.q2_text: Program I want most is leadership and social impact because I care about student problems and I don't like when everybody just complain and then nothing move. I want learn how take concern and make it to action. My English maybe not perfect and sometimes I speak not so clear, but I know I am serious in this and I really want improve this side.
candidate_breakdown.q3_text: Big challenge for me was first year when I joined one student project team. Very fast I saw people say many motivated words but actually nobody organize work. At first I keep quiet because I think maybe I am too new and maybe I should not speak. But deadline come closer and confusion stay same, so I made simple task plan, timeline, and who can do what. It was not beautiful and not everyone liked in start, but later it helped us finish in time. What helped me there was understanding that waiting for perfect moment is more dangerous than making one useful step.
candidate_breakdown.q4_text: My long term goal is become person who can lead education or youth projects, maybe nonprofit, maybe social entrepreneurship, I am still learning exact direction. But I know I want work where strategy and human meaning go together. This program can help me because I need stronger environment, mentors, and people who also want build something. What motivates me is when I see small organized effort can really improve something for others.
candidate_breakdown.q5_text: For me leadership is not being loudest. Leadership is when people feel lost and somebody can bring clarity, movement, and trust. One time in volunteer event two team members stop joining because they think their work is not important. I talked with them one by one, asked what work they can take comfortable, and then changed our plan little bit so roles become more clear. After this they become active again and preparation was much smoother. For me this was important because I learn leadership is also seeing people, not only pushing tasks.
candidate_breakdown.q6_text: Yes my family supports me. Sometimes they worry I take too much responsibility, but they support because they know I am serious. Biggest encouragement is my mother because she always says confidence comes after action, not before.
